soak-5.note: 60 min, soak-5 with a Deck Terminal running kubectl get pods -n wh-perf -w through Gangway (live test cluster, load 5.6 at start). Passes growth (0.0 MB), leaks (0), threads, fds and slope. FAILS the peak footprint budget: 265 MB against 200. M4a recorded 233 MB without a terminal, so the peak is mostly the shared 5-cluster/2-window workload (first sample 122 MB, peak early in the run, low 161 MB); the terminal's own share was not separated.
